item.title: Ohio State Beats Northwestern in Evanston, 86-82, As Brandon Noel Scores Season-High 29 Points
item.description: The Brandon Noel Game. In a back-and-forth affair in Evanston, Ohio State leaned on Noel to provide a much-needed spark for the Buckeyes on Saturday afternoon. The sixth-year senior notched a season-high 29 points and seven rebounds while leading OSU to an 86-82 win on the road at Northwestern. item.title: Ohio State Club Football Wins Back-to-Back National Championships
item.description: Ohio State's club football team is officially a dynasty, if it wasn't already. For the second time in as many years, Ohio State's club football team won the NCFA championship on Saturday. Led by quarterback Niko Pappas, who broke the NCFA league single-season record for touchdowns along the way, the No.1 Buckeyes took down No. 2 Coppin State, 28-8, a game that OSU was in control of from start to finish. item.title: Jeremiah Smith Surpasses 1,000 Receiving Yards for Second Straight Season
item.description: Jeremiah Smith keeps etching his name in the Ohio State record books. Last year, he became the first Buckeye freshman ever to record 1,000 receiving yards in a season. In the 12th game he played of his sophomore campaign, Smith crossed the 1,000-yard threshold once again, joining Marvin Harrison Jr. as the only two Ohio State players to record back-to-back 1,000-yard seasons. item.title: Ohio State Running Back Bo Jackson Becomes Fifth Freshman With 1,000 Single-Season Rushing Yards
item.description: Bo Jackson has had a historic freshman season. In Ohio State's Big Ten Championship Game matchup with Indiana, Jackson surpassed 1,000 rushing yards in 2025, becoming the fifth freshman to accomplish the feat, joining Robert Smith (1990), Maurice Clarett (2002), J.K. Dobbins (2017) and TreVeyon Henderson (2021). Jackson is the 28th Buckeye to surpass 1,000 rushing yards in a single season since 1960, with those 28 players combining for 40 1,000-yard years.
